description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open-source testing management system. It manages and displays milestone information for a specific test plan, initializing the page, checking user rights, and rendering the milestone view template.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic PHP object used to construct objects with dynamic properties.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine class used for rendering templates in the TestLink interface.

classes.name: milestone_mgr
classes.description: Manager class responsible for retrieving milestone data related to test plans.

classes.name: tlTestPlanMetrics
classes.description: Class used for calculating and retrieving metrics associated with test plan milestones.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns an object with session-based arguments such as test project and test plan IDs and names.

methods.name: initialize_gui
methods.description: Sets up GUI variables and fetches milestone data for a specific test plan using manager classes, returning a configured GUI object.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has rights to access test plan planning and view events, enforcing access control.
